# How to convert IsaacLab ContactSensor world frame contact forces to fingertip or body local frame?

> **Current answer:** The original poster explicitly states that the ContactSensor always returns contact forces in the world frame. To obtain the local frame, one must first obtain the relative pose of the target body in the world frame from body_state_w, ContactSensor.track_pose, or the FrameTransformer, and then rotate the force vector using the isaaclab.utils.math module. The FrameTransformer itself only provides the pose transformation, and does not directly convert forces. The original thread does not provide complete formulas and retests, and has not answered the coordinate system of get_measured_joint_forces, so the implementation must use known direction loads to validate the rotation direction and sign.
